units.source_text: 此时右近才说出了昔年夕颜暴死之事。

en.t: Only then did Ukon tell the story of how Yugao had suddenly died years before.

units.source_text: 她说：“当时公子非常悲恸，永远不能忘怀。

en.t: She said, "At that time, the young lord was overcome with grief and could never forget her.

units.source_text: 他那时曾对我说：‘让我抚育她的遗孤，借以代替她吧。

en.t: Back then he said to me, 'Let me raise the child she left behind, as a way of taking her place.
I have few children, and my household is lonely.

units.source_text: 对人但言我找到了一个亲生女儿可也。’

en.t: To others, I need only say that I have found a daughter of my own.'

units.source_text: 那时我年纪还轻，没有主意，凡事小心谨慎，不敢泄露夫人暴死之事。

en.t: At that time I was still young and had no judgment of my own, so I was cautious in everything and did not dare reveal the lady's sudden death.

units.source_text: 因此不曾到西京来寻访。

en.t: For that reason, I never came to Nishikyo to search for her.

units.source_text: 这期间你家主人升了少弍，我从名单上知道此事。

en.t: During that time, your master was promoted to Shoni, and I learned of it from the official list.

units.source_text: 少弍来向公子告辞之日，我曾看见他一面，但终于不曾交谈。

en.t: On the day the Shoni came to take leave of the young lord, I caught sight of him once, but in the end I never spoke with him.

units.source_text: 我以为你们自赴筑紫，把小姐遗留在五条的租屋里了。

en.t: I thought you had all gone off to Tsukushi yourselves and had left the young lady behind in the rented house at Gojo.

units.source_text: 哎呀，差一点，小姐险些儿做了乡下人。”

en.t: Ah, what a close thing it was; the young lady very nearly became a country girl."
